scope: CANFIRE suppression retains the event contact
defect: A CANFIRE opportunity for one enemy could select the first qualifying unrelated enemy from sorted native knowledge.
change: Require matching cause/position/observation time between active response and surviving event; use that live hostile identity to select only its current native believed position. Existing ordinary hidden/drill/reported suppression remains unchanged.
cost: Bounded existing known-contact search; no world query, new worker, target reveal, live hostile position read or new controller.
source_intent: Reference brainEngage passes its actual target into doSuppress/getHideFrom. CBE keeps a group rotation but retains that contact identity; no source-parity claim.
